<title level="1" right="Class Feature 1">[Taunt](/Classes.aspx?ID=67)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 37

**Class** Guardian
</column>

---

Often, the best way to protect your allies is to have the enemy want to attack you instead. You gain the Taunt action.
